normalized_cause: Keep daytime windows out of the 24-hour predicate
evidence_summary: When the canonical 07:00–19:00 daytime window is passed, the added range condition makes `is_24h_shift` return true; because `classify_shift` checks that predicate first, the window is incorrectly returned as `covered_by_24h` instead of `covered_by_12h_day`. The broadened predicate also misclassifies other non-24-hour windows such as 06:00–20:00, so the 24-hour check must remain limited to a full-day wrap.
